facts.text: The user asked for examples of cover songs that were transformed into something new and unique.
The user said they had heard Jimi Hendrix's version before.
The user did not know that Jimi Hendrix's version was a cover song.
The user said they had no idea that "I Will Always Love You" was a cover by Dolly Parton.
The user asked whether there are other popular songs that are actually covers.
The user said they had no idea that "Yesterday" was written by Paul McCartney and not credited to Lennon-McCartney.
The user said the true origins of some songs can get lost over time.
The user asked for other songs where the original writer didn't get enough credit.

keyphrases: I Will Always Love You cover
